description: Indore advocate's bilingual card, front + back. Front: all-caps firm name 'BHARGAVA & ASSOCIATES', 'Advocates & Legal Consultants' strap, 'Adv.' name line with the degree strings INLINE (', B.Sc., LL.B.'), a Devanagari name line OCR'd by the eng model into junk, 'Advocate & Notary' designation, Bar Council 'Enrolment No. MP/1247/2004' (digits look like a phone; the label remainder looks like a 3-word name sitting right next to the title), a 'Practising at High Court … & District Courts' line, 'Cell :' with two comma-separated mobiles, 'Off. : … | Res. : …' landlines on one line (Res. is a home phone — the bench runner cannot assert home-phone, so only the Off. number is checked), e-mail + website on one '|' line. Back: 'Chamber :' heading, two address lines with spaced PIN 'Indore - 452 001 (M.P.)' and state in brackets, timings written without am/pm ('10.30 - 1.30 & 5.30 - 8.30') which look like a 7-digit phone, 'Also at : Civil Court, Dewas' filler.
